short.q: Why did John Williams use a late-Romantic orchestra for Star Wars?
short.model: It gives a grand, heroic, emotional sound that links to Wagner and Holst and told the audience immediately that this was an epic adventure.

short.q: Describe how Defying Gravity builds to its climax.
short.model: It grows from quiet to loud with crescendo, rising melody, an ostinato, key changes and belted vocals with full orchestra.
It blends Irish sean-nós and instruments with West African drums and electronic dance beats and samples.

short.q: Describe the rhythm of Samba Em Prelúdio.
short.model: A syncopated samba rhythm with a lilting feel and changes of tempo, played by drums and percussion with a walking-style bass.

short.q: Give two similarities between Release and Killer Queen.
short.model: Both use layered multi-tracked recording and studio effects, and both have a strong rhythm section with repeated patterns.
